name: Leeds Beckett University
description:
Leeds Beckett University dates all the way back to 1824 and the founding of the Leeds Mechanics Institute. By 1970 it had become Leeds Polytechnic before gaining university status in 1992. In 2014 it adopted its current name, changing from Leeds Metropolitan University. Today it hosts nearly 24,000 students a year including international students from more than 143 countries.

It ranked in the top 800 global universities in the 2022 Times Higher Education rankings. It is also placed just outside the top 100 UK universities in the Complete University Guide and guides from The Guardian and The Times/Sunday Times. It has also come second in the University of the Year award by The Times Higher Education Supplement and was commended for its â€˜low-charging, high energyâ€™ strategy.

The Leeds Beckett University acceptance rate is over 75-80%.

Student Life

Leeds Beckett University is ranked 6th in the UK for Student Life according to the Whatuni Student Choice Awards 2022. The awards are based on reviews from university students around the UK.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Leeds Beckett University is a vibrant and modern institution with a rich history that dates back to 1824. In 2014, it adopted the name Leeds Beckett University. Today, the university is home to nearly 24,000 students like you.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value: At Leeds Beckett University, you’ll join a vibrant and inclusive community with students from over 140 countries. You’ll have a lot of support here, as the university offers a wide range of support services, including counselling, health services, and academic guidance. Additionally, the Leeds Beckett Student Union (LBSU) enhances your student experience by organising events, societies, and wellness initiatives.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Leeds Beckett University offers you a range of accommodation options. From modern en-suite rooms to shared flats and studio rooms, you'll find comfortable living spaces across several university-managed residences. Homestays are also an option in some locations, offering you the chance to experience local culture and receive additional support from a host family.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
Leeds Beckett’s libraries, located at both the City and Headingley campuses, are open 24/7 during term time. You’ll find a wide range of resources, from books and journals to digital tools and quiet study spaces.

Sports
Whether you're into competitive sports or just want to stay active, you’ll find everything you need at Leeds Beckett University! This includes top-notch sports facilities like Carnegie Sports Centre and the Headingley Campus gym, fitness suites and indoor courts, outdoor pitches and more.

Laboratory
Leeds Beckett features modern, fully equipped labs across a variety of disciplines, including biomedical science, computing, engineering, psychology, and more.

Cafeteria
Leeds Beckett University offers you several dining and café options across its City and Headingley campuses. These include the Beckett Kitchen, R.B. Espresso, Gaia Café, Carnegie Café, and many more spots for quick bites.
